contentHtml:
Plate short ribs are a rich, comforting dish featuring tender, fall-off-the-bone meat simmered in a deep, savory sauce. Cooked with beef broth, garlic, herbs, tomato paste, and a touch of vinegar and soy sauce for balance, the ribs develop bold, slow-cooked flavor and a velvety texture. Perfect served over mashed potatoes or noodles, plate short ribs make a hearty, satisfying meal ideal for family dinners or special occasions.

Why You’ll Love This Plate Short Ribs

  • Melts in your mouth with every bite.
  • Rich, savory flavors that warm the soul.
  • Perfect for cozy gatherings or special occasions.

  • Leftovers taste even better the next day!

Plate Short Ribs

Discover the ultimate braised plate short ribs recipe! Tender, flavorful, and easy to make, this dish will impress your taste buds! 🍽️✨
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 3 hours hrs
marinating 2 hours hrs
Total Time 5 hours hrs 15 minutes mins
Servings: 6 servings
Course: Main Course
Cuisine: Asian
Calories: 350
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Main Ingredients
  • 3 pounds Plate Short Ribs Well-marbled for tenderness.
  • 1/2 cup Soy Sauce For savory depth.
  • 1/4 cup Brown Sugar Adds sweetness.
  • 6 cloves Garlic Minced for flavor.
  • 1 tablespoon Fresh Ginger Grated for spice.
  • 4 stalks Green Onions Chopped for garnish.
  • 2 tablespoons Sesame Oil For nutty aroma.
  • 1 teaspoon Black Pepper To taste.
  • 1/2 teaspoon Red Pepper Flakes For a bit of heat.
  • 2 cups Beef Broth or Water For braising.

Equipment

  • 1 Heavy pot For searing and braising the ribs.

Method
 

Instructions
  1. Step 1: Season the Ribs – Start by seasoning the plate short ribs generously with salt and pepper. This simple step is crucial for enhancing the flavor.
  2. Step 2: Make the Marinade – In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. This marinade will add a delicious depth to your ribs.
  3. Step 3: Marinate the Ribs – Place the seasoned ribs in the marinade, ensuring they are well-coated. Cover and let them marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight if you can wait!
  4. Step 4: Sear the Ribs – Preheat a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Once hot, sear the ribs on all sides until they are beautifully browned. This step locks in the flavors.
  5. Step 5: Prepare the Cooking Liquid – Remove the ribs from the pot and set them aside. Pour in the marinade and beef broth (or water), scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. This adds even more flavor!
  6. Step 6: Cook the Ribs – Return the ribs to the pot, bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover and reduce the heat. Let them cook on low for 2½ to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
  7. Step 7: Serve and Enjoy – Once cooked, garnish the ribs with sliced green onions. Serve hot and enjoy the tender, flavorful goodness of your plate short ribs!

How to Make Plate Short Ribs

This delightful recipe for Plate Short Ribs requires a preparation time of about 15 minutes, a cooking time of 2½ to 3 hours, and a marinating time of at least 2 hours or overnight for maximum flavor. Get ready for some tender, flavorful goodness!

Step 1: Season the Ribs

Start by seasoning the plate short ribs generously with salt and pepper. This simple step is crucial for enhancing the flavor.

Step 2: Make the Marinade

In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, grated ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. This marinade will add a delicious depth to your ribs.

Step 3: Marinate the Ribs

Place the seasoned ribs in the marinade, ensuring they are well-coated. Cover and let them marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight if you can wait!

Step 4: Sear the Ribs

Preheat a heavy pot over medium-high heat. Once hot, sear the ribs on all sides until they are beautifully browned. This step locks in the flavors.

Step 5: Prepare the Cooking Liquid

Remove the ribs from the pot and set them aside. Pour in the marinade and beef broth (or water), scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. This adds even more flavor!

Step 6: Cook the Ribs

Return the ribs to the pot, bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover and reduce the heat. Let them cook on low for 2½ to 3 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.

Step 7: Serve and Enjoy

Once cooked, garnish the ribs with sliced green onions. Serve hot and enjoy the tender, flavorful goodness of your plate short ribs!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making Plate Short Ribs

  • Choose well-marbled short ribs for maximum flavor and tenderness.
  • Brown the ribs thoroughly for a rich, deep flavor.
  • Use low-sodium beef broth to control saltiness.
  • Add a splash of apple cider vinegar for a tangy kick.
  • Let the ribs rest after cooking for juicier results.

How to Serve this Plate Short Ribs

  • Serve over creamy mashed potatoes for a comforting meal.
  • Pair with roasted seasonal vegetables for a colorful plate.
  • Top with fresh herbs like parsley or thyme for a pop of flavor.
  • Accompany with a side of crusty bread to soak up the delicious sauce.
  • Try it with a side of tangy coleslaw for a crunchy contrast.
  • Serve with a refreshing cucumber salad to balance the richness.

Make Ahead and Storage

Storing and reheating your Plate Short Ribs is simple and keeps them delicious!

Storing Plate Short Ribs Leftovers

  • Allow the ribs to cool to room temperature.
  • Transfer to an airtight container.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
  • Label with the date for easy tracking.

Freezing Plate Short Ribs

  • Cool the ribs completely before freezing.
  • Wrap tightly in plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Place in a freezer-safe container or bag.
  • Freeze for up to 3 months for best quality.

Reheating Plate Short Ribs

  • Thaw in the refrigerator overnight if frozen.
  • Reheat in a covered skillet over low heat.
  • Add a splash of broth or water to keep moist.
  • Alternatively, use the oven at 300°F until heated through.

FAQs

Here’s a helpful FAQ about this recipe:

1. What is the difference between short ribs and plate short ribs?

Short ribs come from the rib section of the cow, while plate short ribs are specifically cut from the plate primal, which is located further down the rib cage. Plate short ribs are typically meatier and have more fat, making them ideal for braising and slow cooking, resulting in a tender and flavorful dish.

2. Does Costco sell plate ribs?

Yes, Costco often carries plate short ribs, especially in their meat department. Availability may vary by location, so it’s a good idea to check with your local store or their website to see if they have them in stock. They are usually sold in larger quantities, perfect for family gatherings or meal prepping.

3. What exactly are plate ribs?

Plate ribs are a specific cut of beef that comes from the plate primal of the cow. This cut is known for its rich marbling and flavor, making it ideal for slow cooking methods like braising. They are typically larger and thicker than other short rib cuts, providing a hearty and satisfying meal when cooked properly.

4. What’s the best way to cook plate ribs?

The best way to cook plate short ribs is to braise them. Start by searing the ribs in a hot pan to develop a nice crust, then transfer them to a Dutch oven or slow cooker. Add your choice of broth, vegetables, and seasonings, and cook low and slow for several hours until the meat is tender and falls off the bone. This method enhances the flavors and ensures a melt-in-your-mouth experience.

Final Thoughts

Imagine the aroma filling your kitchen and the smiles around the table as you serve this delightful dish. It’s simple, rewarding, and perfect for any occasion. So roll up your sleeves, dive in, and enjoy every delicious bite!
